entries.head: logql
entries.message: logql: range op %s is not yet supported
entries.rationale: unreachable: every lexer-producible range op is mapped (rate/bytes_rate/rate_counter/count/bytes plus the *_over_time family incl. first/last; absent_over_time routes to lowerAbsentOverTime first); the dunder sharding ops (__quantile_sketch_over_time__, __first/last_over_time_ts__) have no lexer tokens

guard: past exhaustive switch op over [case syntax.OpRangeTypeRate, syntax.OpRangeTypeBytesRate; case syntax.OpRangeTypeRateCounter; case syntax.OpRangeTypeCount; case syntax.OpRangeTypeBytes; case syntax.OpRangeTypeSum, syntax.OpRangeTypeAvg, syntax.OpRangeTypeMin, syntax.OpRangeTypeMax, syntax.OpRangeTypeStddev, syntax.OpRangeTypeStdvar, syntax.OpRangeTypeQuantile, syntax.OpRangeTypeFirst, syntax.OpRangeTypeLast]
